title: LionGuard: Building a Contextualized Moderation Classifier to Tackle Localized Unsafe Content
reasoning: The paper focuses on building a safety moderation classifier specifically for the Singaporean context (Singlish). While its safety taxonomy includes a 'Hateful' category that covers content targeting religion, this is treated as a standard safety/toxicity classification task. The paper does not contain a specific component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as primary research subjects beyond the scope of general safety moderation.
